english_translation.translator: K. M. K. Murthy / Desiraju Hanumanta Rao
english_translation.text: "While that Rama was going on exile, Lakshmana, endowed with humbleness, and augmentor of his mother Sumitra's joy, and a loving and a dear brother to Rama, followed him out of affection, showing brotherly fraternity.[1-1-25, 26a]

english_translation.translator: K. M. K. Murthy / Desiraju Hanumanta Rao
english_translation.text: "Even Seetha, daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, and Rama's beloved wife equalling to Rama's life, ever well disposed, born in the family of Janaka and one as though fashioned by a Divine marvel, endowed with all good characteristics and the best among women, followed Rama to forest, like Rohini following the Moon... [1-1-26b, 27, 28a]

english_commentary.text: व्रजन्तम् is an accusative case of व्रजत् with व्रज् as its root.

Here devamaayaa refers to many concepts. VaiShNavaite tenets tell that the word deva is ascribable only to Vishnu, but not to other gods. Thus, this is ViShNumaayaa, when He assumed an extraordinary female form called Mohini, when distributing amR^ita, the divine elixir, to gods and demons. Next is the form of Tilottama, a divine beauty to hoodwink demons called Sunda and Upasunda. The other is Vishnu's liilaa shakti, which is divinely fascinating. Yet another is grammatical connotation, maa yaa where, maa= Goddess Lakshmi; yaa= who that is; meaning yaa siitaa saa maa= 'who is Goddess Lakshmi... She is Seetha...' and this results in the saying: ati ruupavatii siitaa... ati muurkhaH cha raavaNa 'While Seetha is extraordinarily beautiful, Ravana is exceedingly stupid...

hindi_translation.text: अपने सुबन्धुत्वका परिचय देते हुए। और रामके प्राणोंके समान प्रियतमा पत्नी, सदा ही पतिका हित चाहनेवाली
जनकके कुलमें उत्पन्न, अवतीर्ण हुई देवमायाकी भाँति सुन्दरी, समस्त शुभलक्षणोंसे विभूषित, स्त्रियोंमें उत्तम वधू

words.hindi: प्रदर्शित करता हुआ (शतृ प्रत्ययान्त, प्रथमा विभक्ति)

hindi_translation_gitapress.provenance: OCR, unverified; rights: uploader label CC0, original copyright may remain
hindi_translation_gitapress.text: 'और जनकके कुलमें उत्पन्न सीता भी, जो अवतीर्ण हुई देवमायाकी भाँति सुन्दरी, समस्त शुभलक्षणोंसे विभूषित, स्त्रियामें उत्तम, रामके प्राणोंके समान प्रियतमा पली तथा सदा ही पतिका हित चाहनेवाली थी, रामचन्द्रजीके पीछे चली; जैसे चन्द्रमाके पीछे रोहिणी चलती है। उस समय पिता दशरथ [ने अपना सारथि भेजकर] और पुरवासी मनुष्योंने [स्वयं साथ जाकर] दूरतक उनका अनुसरण किया॥ २६-२८॥
